summary: This video showcases two Shadow element team setups for the Mekkatorque endgame boss in Season 8. The first setup relies on Aspalta and Saverio alongside Seyir, Daphne, and Jar'ah, achieving around 700 million damage on default skill timings. The second setup replaces Aspalta and Saverio with Astaion and The Dark Lady, reaching up to 1.8 billion damage. Seyir serves as the core DPS in both builds, benefiting heavily from attack speed, high Enlightenment, and Inspiration 5. Using custom skill timings on the second team enables it to deal nearly three times the damage of the first team.

heroes.name: Seyir
heroes.note: Acts as the primary damage dealer against Mekkatorque; with high Enlightenment, attack speed, and Inspiration 5, Seyir enables teams to achieve up to 1.8 billion damage.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Requires full mythic gear and exclusive artifact in the first setup, but results in lower damage (700M) compared to the Astaion setup.

heroes.name: Aspalta
heroes.note: Built with attack speed, accuracy, and witch's remains gear set to trigger bleeding synergies in the first showcase.

heroes.name: The Dark Lady
heroes.note: Runs with Golden Antlers and attack-sharing gear on a 30-second skill timing rotation.

heroes.name: Astaion
heroes.note: Provides accuracy sharing and resistance stats, operating on a 15-second skill timing rotation.

heroes.name: Daphne
heroes.note: Equipped with attack-sharing gear and attack speed, running on default skill timing in both compositions.

teams.note: Full auto default timing team that hits around 700 million damage.
Optimized timing team reaching 1.8 billion damage with a 15s rotation for Seyir/Astaion/Jar'ah and 30s for The Dark Lady.

tips: Prioritize Enlightenment, attack speed, and Inspiration on Seyir to drastically increase total damage output.
Equip attack-sharing gear sets across multiple support heroes to multiply the damage of your main DPS.
Manual skill timing adjustments (15s rotation for DPS/supports and 30s for long buffs) yield significantly higher damage than default auto timing.
